name: Ixtangi
body:
IXTANGI
CR 1

XP 400
N Medium monstrous humanoid
Init +1; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 12, touch 11, flat-footed 11 (+1 Dex, +1 armor)
hp 15 (2d10+4)
Fort +2, Ref +4, Will +3
Defensive Abilities liquid crystal display (stealth)

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., climb 20 ft.
Melee survival knife +3 (1d4 P or S, 19–20/×2), barbed tail –2 (1d4 P plus critical effect [DC 13]) or barbed tail +3 (1d4 P plus critical effect [DC 13])
Ranged compact semi-automatic pistol +3 (1d6/×4 B&P, range incr. 20 ft., semiautomatic, AP 4 CW)
Special Attacks liquid crystal display (glimmer [DC 12])

STATISTICS

Str 11 (+0); Dex 12 (+1); Con 14 (+2); Int 12 (+1); Wis 10 (+0); Cha 13 (+1)
Base Atk +2; CMB +2; CMD 13
Feats Weapon Finesse
Skills Climb +16, Acrobatics +3, Diplomacy +3, Knowledge (local) +3, Perception +5, Stealth +6
Languages Common, Ixtangi
SQ expert climber

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Barbed Tail (Ex)

An ixtangi’s barbed tail is a primary natural attack that deals piercing damage. If the ixtangi scores a critical hit with their tail attack, their target must succeed at a DC 13 Fortitude save or gain the flat-footed condition until the end of the ixtangi’s next turn. This is a poison effect, and the save DC is Constitutionbased.

Expert Climber (Ex)

Ixtangi have a climb speed of 20 feet, and gain a +16 species bonus to Climb checks. An ixtangi can use their sticky paw pads, tongue, and prehensile tail to stay stuck to walls and even ceilings as long as the surface has hand- and footholds. In effect, they are treated as being constantly under the effects of a non-magical spider climb effect, save that they cannot cling to smooth surfaces.

Liquid Crystal Display (Ex)

Ixtangi have an innate ability to change their coloration as a standard action in order to produce one of the following effects.

Glimmer: The ixtangi flashes their coloration in a display that distracts onlookers. Enemies within 30 feet that can see the ixtangi must succeed at a DC 12 Will save or be fascinated for 1d4 rounds. A creature can only be affected by this ability once per day. This is a mind-affecting effect, and the save DC is Charisma-based.
Stealth: The ixtangi mimics their surroundings, becoming almost invisible. They gain a +4 species bonus to Stealth checks to hide until the beginning of their next turn.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, pair, or glimmer (3–10)
Treasure NPC gear (stationwear, compact semi-automatic pistol with 2 clips [10 rounds each], survival knife, other gear)

The ixtangi are a species of chameleon-like reptilian humanoids native to several jungle planets throughout the Galaxy. They have V-shaped heads that space their large eyes wide apart on either side of a central snout.

These eyes can, and often do, move independently, which can be disconcerting for some. In general, however, most people find ixtangi to be outgoing and personable.

The natural coloration of an ixtangi is some shade of green, yellow, blue, red, or black.

However, their glass-like scales function similar to a liquid crystal display—able to change color with ease to mimic their surroundings.

Ixtangi are tall and lean. Within their own society, most place a high priority on fashion. They have a long tail that ends in a wicked barbed stinger, which they usually keep wrapped innocuously around themselves but will keep poised at the ready when danger lurks.

Ixtangi occupy many different planets, and their circumstances are different on different worlds. On some worlds, they face challenges in the form of jungle hazards and predators, while on others they face magical threats or pressures to the natural environment from over-industrialization.

The ixtangi have tried many solutions to these challenges, some of which have had great success, while others have met with disaster. As such, many species have a mixed opinion of them—often admiring them for their tenacity, but also wary of becoming part of the next “ixtangi catastrophe.”
